visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy brown hair wearing an olive green shirt over a dark tee stands against a white window background, holding an electric cleaning brush and various brush heads. Overlays show the product cleaning a pan with white foam in a kitchen sink. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a dirty, burnt pan. A hand pours green liquid soap onto a yellow sponge attachment mounted on the electric brush. The man appears in a circular inset, looking skeptical. (3) The electric brush rotates against the burnt pan surface under running water, scrubbing away dark residue. The pan is then tilted to show a clean, reflective surface. (4) The brush is used to clean a white plate covered in red pasta sauce. The man reacts with a surprised expression in a new scene. (5) The man points the brush toward the camera, surrounded by pink heart graphics. The camera shifts to a close-up of a dirty sink drain being scrubbed with a nylon brush head, marked by a red circling overlay. (6) A metal drain strainer is held under running water and scrubbed clean. The man is then shown vigorously scrubbing the side of the stainless steel sink, looking satisfied at the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator presenting the product.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with medium-length wavy dark hair, wearing a green button-down shirt over a black t-shirt and a beaded bracelet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A kitchen setting with a stainless steel sink, a modern faucet, and a tiled wall. Some shots feature a white window pane as a studio-style backdrop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-arousal male narration introduces the product. Upbeat, bouncy synth BGM starts immediately. Sound of an electric motor whirring is layered under the speech. (2) A mechanical click is heard as a brush head is attached. Vocal tone becomes skeptical and lower pitched. Ambient splashing water begins. (3) A loud 'Whoosh' transition SFX triggers a new phase. Motor scrubbing sounds intensify as the narrator describes burnt sauce. A comedic 'Ding' sound accompanies a visual highlight. (4) Enthusiastic vocal 'Wow' with high pitch variability. The BGM maintains a steady, energetic beat. Sound of scrubbing on porcelain is prominent. (5) Transition SFX leads to a segment with higher-energy vocal exclamations ('欸!', '強欸!'). SFX of bubbles or popping sounds are added for comedic effect during the drain cleaning. (6) The final phase features a fast, rhythmic summary from the narrator with a satisfied, conclusive tone. BGM swells slightly before a hard cut silence at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Demonstration -> Benefit -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote an electric cleaning brush by demonstrating its effectiveness in various difficult cleaning scenarios, such as burnt pans, saucy plates, and dirty sink drains. It uses a comedic and high-energy tone to appeal to viewers who dislike household chores.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a dedicated showcase of the product's functions with call-to-action style subtitles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses variety-show style editing, including frequent text overlays and sound effects, to maintain high engagement.
